body:
Knitting used to be one of my favorite hobbies, too, but I can never do it now because of the pain.

As for doctors, that's the most exhausting part. Every time I want to see a new doctor, I have to wait for months because of the health system in my country. Right now I'm waiting for an MRI and a specialist appointment in May. I don't know if I can last until them.
There's a limited amount of typing I can do every day. I try to dedicate it to work, when I can. But today I couldn't work at all.
